parameters.query:
SELECT lead_id, lead_score
  FROM leads
 WHERE status = 'novo'
   AND score_band = 'quente'
   AND NOT do_not_email
 ORDER BY lead_score DESC
 LIMIT 20;

SELECT rep_id, name, email, team
  FROM sales_reps
 WHERE active
 ORDER BY rep_id;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE leads
     SET status = 'enviado', assigned_rep_id = $2, dispatched_at = now()
   WHERE lead_id = $1 AND status = 'novo'
  RETURNING lead_id
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_dispatches (lead_id, rep_id, channel)
  SELECT lead_id, $2, 'email' FROM upd
  RETURNING dispatch_id, lead_id
)
SELECT ins.dispatch_id, l.lead_id, l.full_name, l.email, l.phone, l.lead_source,
       l.last_activity, l.occupation, l.lead_score, l.total_visits,
       ROUND(l.time_on_site_sec / 60.0, 1) AS minutos_no_site,
       r.name AS rep_name, r.email AS rep_email
  FROM ins
  JOIN leads l      ON l.lead_id = ins.lead_id
  JOIN sales_reps r ON r.rep_id  = $2;
